category_title: Preschoolers exhibiting desirable social behaviors such as sharing and following classroom rules
minimal_context: The student is in the classroom and is expected to put the toys away and share with friends.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to put the toys away now.

STUDENT: (Runs in the classroom instead of putting the toys away) I am still playing!

TUTOR: Please stop running and help with the toys.

STUDENT: (Grabs a toy from another child, refusing to share with friends) I want this one!

TUTOR: What should you do with your friends?

STUDENT: (Pushes the friend and throws the toy at them) No!

options.A: Provide the student with detailed instructions for each specific element of putting the toys away in the classroom.
options.B: Ask the student how they would feel if a friend pushed them, prompting them to empathize and think about how others feel.
options.C: Direct the student to take a few minutes away from their friends to calm down before returning to the toys.
options.D: Provide the student with advance warnings before transitioning from playing with toys to cleaning up the classroom.
